normalizedHtml.method: Strip the archive publication prefix, canonicalize generated _astro hash filenames to stable basename/extension tokens, and normalize Astro island uid values. Metadata and links remain separately recorded without discarding their expected publication-context values.

approvedDifferences: Base-prefixed canonical, Open Graph, favicon, asset, and nested route URLs required by the Base-aware publication URL specification.

stableAssets.definition: All copied public assets and fonts; excludes HTML, generated _astro assets, and Astro adapter support files content-assets.mjs, content-modules.mjs, and data-store.json.
stableAssets.baselinePublicSourcePathSetAndBytesEqual: not-verifiable: checked-in baseline has an aggregate hash but no pre-migration public tree; the candidate is not compared by assumption

stableAssets.globalOwnershipBoundary: robots.txt is present in the historical baseline source but is intentionally no longer app-owned after Slice 5 distribution ownership; it is excluded from application stable-asset parity.
